teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'hyena's residence', a dense tangle of the coastal thicket.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'makazi ya fisi', kichaka kilichosokotana cha vichaka vizito vya pwani.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'makalo ga fisi'; ni chitsaka chiziho chirichodzilinga-linga kahi ya vitsaka vya pwani.

summary.en: *Mkala fisi* is a scrambling shrub of the coastal thicket with rough, sandpapery leaves. Its name, 'hyena's residence', is shared with Duruma and Swahili.
summary.sw: *Mkala fisi* ni kichaka kinachotambaa cha vichaka vizito vya pwani chenye majani yenye ukwaru kama msasa. Jina lake, 'makazi ya fisi', linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili.
summary.dg: *Mkala fisi* ni chitsaka chinachokpwera cha vitsaka vya pwani, chenye makodza ganayokaraza dza msasa. Dzinare, 'makalo ga fisi', nkuhumirwa piya ni Aduruma na Aswahili.

about.en: *Mkala fisi* is a scrambling shrub that climbs and sprawls through other bushes. Its leaves are rough to the touch, like sandpaper, a trait it shares with several unrelated coastal plants.
about.sw: *Mkala fisi* ni kichaka kinachotambaa ambacho hupanda na kutanda juu ya vichaka vingine. Majani yake yana ukwaru yakiguswa, kama msasa, sifa kinayoshiriki na mimea kadhaa ya pwani isiyo na uhusiano nacho.
about.dg: *Mkala fisi* ni chitsaka chinachokpwera dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina na kuenea kahi yao. Makodzage ganakaraza uchigaguta, dza msasa, na tabiya hiyo inaphahikana piya kpwa mimea minji ya pwani isiyo ya jamii mwenga nao.

where.en: *Mkala fisi* grows in coastal thicket, the dense tangle of shrubs and climbers that covers much of the coral rag and sandy ground behind the coast.
where.sw: *Mkala fisi* hukua katika vichaka vizito vya pwani, mkusanyiko mzito uliosokotana wa vichaka na mitambaa unaofunika sehemu kubwa ya ardhi ya mawe ya matumbawe na ya mchanga nyuma ya pwani.
where.dg: *Mkala fisi* unamera kahi ya vitsaka vya pwani, phatu ambapho vitsaka na mimea inayokpwera inamera phephi-phephi na kudzilinga-linga, na kubwiningiza tsi nyinji ya sanoo na ya mtsanga nyuma ya pwani.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

culture.sw: Jina *mkala fisi* lina maana ya 'makazi ya fisi'.
culture.dg: Dzina *mkala fisi* rina mana ya 'makalo ga fisi'.

names.en: Digo: *mkala fisi*, a name shared with Duruma and Swahili. It is also called *mzondohera nguluwe*, 'wiper of the pig's buttocks', a name more often given to the sandpaper saucer-berry (*Cordia monoica*). Both plants have rough leaves. No English name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Tetracera boiviniana*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mkala fisi*, jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Pia huitwa *mzondohera nguluwe*, 'mpanguzaji wa makalio ya nguruwe', jina ambalo mara nyingi zaidi hupewa *sandpaper saucer-berry* (*Cordia monoica*). Mimea yote miwili ina majani yenye ukwaru. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi hukiita *Tetracera boiviniana*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mkala fisi*, dzina ambaro Aduruma na Aswahili nao anarihumira. Piya unaihwa *mzondohera nguluwe*, 'chitu cha kuphakusira mahako ga nguluwe', dzina ambaro mara nyinji nkuhewa *Cordia monoica* (kpwa Chingereza *sandpaper saucer-berry*). Mimea yosi miiri ina makodza ganayokaraza. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Tetracera boiviniana*.
